svg.title: Force-torque vibration = A + B + C
svg.text: a · sin(k · φ), φ = ∫ N · q̇ dt
σ = s0 + s1 · act + s2 · moving
sum: what the sensor sees (0.5 s, joint at 45 °/s)
All three are added to the true wrench in front of the sensor adapter.
Each is scaled once per run (run variation). A grows when the load drives the joint (lowering);
B can be fixed in world axes. Values are illustrative.
